blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — A shark that has become a viral sensation in South Korea was coaxed out of a canal in which it was stuck, authorities said on Wednesday, as falling temperatures raised concerns for its survival. The shark — nicknamed “Bukhangi” by fans — was spotted in an artificial waterway in the southeastern port city of Busan last month, with climate activists linking its appearance to climate change. “The shark was guided to the southern entrance of the North Port Waterfront Park, where a net barrier was installed to prevent it from re-entering,” the oceans ministry said in a […]...
